Bundled JavaScript and WASM files are unmodified from the versioned npm package.

The original WASM binary is stored in two byte chunks for static-host asset limits.
Concatenation yields the unmodified original binary. SHA-256: 39f9f0894d478800487ed9f7dbe92618498db320cf55c8e3d89adff8dce658da
